prose: A programming exercise in deliberate constraint: build all the Linux file utilities in C by hand, no AI assistance, in 52 minutes. The point of the exercise is the contrast - measuring what a practiced developer can still do unaided against what the toolchain now does for everyone.
highlights: Livestreamed exercise: reimplement Linux file utilities in C by hand in 52 minutes, no AI
A deliberate-practice counterpoint to AI-assisted development
